0.0.n: This noun names the vehicle being mounted.

0.1.n: に marks the vehicle you get on with 乗る.

0.2.n: 乗る is the plain dictionary form, not a command form.

1.0.n: This noun names the vehicle being mounted.

1.1.n: に marks the vehicle you get on with 乗る.

2.0.n: This noun names the vehicle being dismounted.

2.2.n: 降りる is the plain dictionary form, not a command form.
